 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE NAWNEET KUMAR  PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 4 19-05-2023
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

This is an application for regular bail on behalf of the petitioners for the offences alleged under Sections 420, 406 and 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code registered in connection with Doriganj P.S.Case No. 325 of 2022.

At the outset, the learned learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that co-accused Rajeshwar Kumar, against whom there is allegation of receiving money from the informant, has been granted bail by the learned court below on the basis of compromise petition.
There is no allegation against the petitioners that they had received money from the informant.
The petitioners are in custody since 05.11.2022.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.5168 of 2023(4) dt.19-05-2023

Considering the above facts and circumstances, let the petitioners, above-named, be released on bail Khushboo Kumari vs The State Of Bihar on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128706647/
1 on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/-(ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-VI, Saran at Chapra in connection with Doriganj P.S.Case No. 325 of 2022,
